description: Player 2's deck for the combat spec. #56 Jilliax (3/2; Rush, Taunt, Lifesteal, Divine Shield) is the whole far side of the scenario: its Taunt makes every other enemy target illegal (§4.2 step 3), its Divine Shield negates the first damage instance whatever the amount (§4.4 step 1), and its Lifesteal heals player 2's hero by exactly what it dealt (§4.4 step 8). #8 Mr. Vanilla is the second body: the non-Taunt unit that must NOT be highlighted while Jilliax is on the board, and the attacker that runs into player 1's Defense-Position unit. Nothing else in the deck grants a keyword, an Armor or a cost change, so every number the spec asserts comes from the printed stats and the pipeline. No card here carries a start-of-turn, end-of-turn or on-play hook that acts on the board (#58 Rush Token Farm and #64 Gifted Program were removed for exactly that): `triggerHoldersWithHook` in packages/engine/src/triggers.ts gathers those hooks from the HAND as well as the field, so a Rush Token Farm sitting in hand summons a unit every turn and a Gifted Program in hand makes a cheap play Radiant - which would move the board and the stats this spec asserts. Reported as an engine finding; the fixture does not rely on it either way.
